facts.fact: Equinix, a US-headquartered digital infrastructure company, entered South Africa in 2024 with a $160 million investment in its Johannesburg 1 data centre.

Equinix has earmarked a R7.5 billion budget for expansion in South Africa, including land bought in Johannesburg and Cape Town, with no development yet underway on the new sites; the date is not stated, so the published date 2026-08-12 is used.
facts.system: Equinix South Africa R7.5bn expansion budget
